lastEditorialNotes: Strong tip from Chris Dias references the 'Hamid AI hallucinations case' (UK v SSHD [2026] UKUT 81 (IAC)) which could be significant legal development if verified. This Upper Tribunal decision appears to be new and potentially important for AI liability in legal practice. Worth investigating both the case itself and Dias's analysis of supervision frameworks. The combination of practitioner experience and legal AI tool development makes this a valuable voice in the sector.
